name: pokedex-manager
description: Aplicacion web full-stack para gestionar una coleccion personal de Pokemon
author: Daniel Lazcano

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:env && npm run build:shared && npm run db:push
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pokedex/api && npm run build --workspace @pokedex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --build --force apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
